name: ios-studio-extreme
description: iOS Studio Extreme — a browser-based, Android Studio-density IDE optimized for full-screen iPad use. Three-column layout, live linter, Gemini AI copilot, real-time profiler, DOM inspector, global search & replace, and OTA packager. Compiles to an unsigned .ipa via GitHub Actions macos-14 runners.
author: iOS Studio Extreme <developer@example.com>

scripts.build:web: echo "Web assets are static; no build step required." && exit 0
scripts.build:ios:local: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO archive
